description: Sets which privacy regulation one of your CookiePal domains’ banner follows: gdpr, ccpa or both, where both applies GDPR everywhere and CCPA to US visitors at the edge. It changes nothing else about the banner, and then queues a rebuild so the change goes live; if the domain has reached its page-view limit the rebuild is skipped, and the result says so.

domainId.description: Which domain to change. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

name: set_banner_mode
title: Set the banner mode
